causal_evidence: all four environments receive the exact same generation-one mutation candidate pool
the first selected population differs in every environment despite the identical mutation pool
selection ranking reads only accepted P1A net_resource_balance and deterministic lineage checksum tie-breaks
selected populations improve accepted net resource consequence and observed biomass in every diagnostic environment
initially negative shaded-slope and dry-ridge populations evolve to positive mean net resource balance and nonzero recruitment
dry-ridge descendants evolve much deeper roots than floodplain descendants
floodplain and dry-ridge descendants diverge strongly in water preference
shaded-slope descendants evolve greater shade tolerance than sunny-slope descendants
each final population has the best accepted net resource balance in its own native diagnostic environment among the four evolved populations
a second mutation seed produces different genomes/hashes while reproducing the local-specialization phenomenon
truth_boundary: P1B-S2 is a selection chamber over accepted P1A truth, not yet a population ecology runtime. Diagnostic site labels do not affect mutation or selection rules. Seed dispersal is intentionally frozen because migration benefit is not modeled yet. No species classes, biome roles, migration, inter-population competition, presentation, authority, persistence or networking are introduced.
